turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: A real practice negotiation from the Tacto arena (case P11, quality). Hollerau Pumpenwerke buys bearing brackets from Odlewnia Kalwisz, a Polish foundry whose quality scorecard is in the red. The buyer is our agent, Parley: data the arena can check, and packages that cost it the same.

turns.speaker: supplier
turns.from: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
turns.text: Hello, … We are very eager to work with you and to prove ourselves as a great long-term partner for your business! We are happy to present our offer for a price of €47.00 per unit, along with a quality commitment of 6400 ppm.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Dear Marek Lis, … We commit to a binding volume of 15900 pieces a year over 12 months, our full need for this part. Your on-time delivery averaged 70.8% over the last two scorecard quarters (sc:70140@2026Q2, sc:70140@2026Q3). PPI-C241 changed -4.3% (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, @2025-10). The PPI-D351 index changed -17.1% (idx:PPI-D351@2025-02, @2026-02). … We have put together 3 packages; each works equally well for us: EUR 43.13 at 300 ppm · EUR 43.17 at 300 ppm with EUR 150 chargeback · EUR 42.90 at 800 ppm.

turns.speaker: supplier
turns.from: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
turns.text: We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds … We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. … Our terms: a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. … I can do 46.00 EUR for the 800 ppm package.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Our recent complaints against this part averaged 18558 ppm (qn:20005025, qn:20004952, qn:20004756). … We have put together 2 packages; each works equally well for us: EUR 43.98 at 300 ppm · EUR 44.02 at 300 ppm with EUR 150 chargeback. What would you need from us to move further?

turns.speaker: supplier
turns.from: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
turns.text: We checked the quality records you cited, but we already took this kind of fact into account. You asked what we need to move further: we really need faster payment, cash is tight for us right now. … Our terms: a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Our latest forecast shows demand for this part up 20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09). … EUR 44.49 at 300 ppm · EUR 44.53 with EUR 150 chargeback. What is the best price you could sign today on one of these packages?

turns.speaker: supplier
turns.from: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
turns.text: We checked the forecast data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. I can do 45.50 EUR for the 300 ppm package with 0 EUR chargeback, this is the best we can do today. … Which volume can you commit to?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: We commit to a binding volume of 15900 pieces a year over 12 months, our full need for this part. … EUR 44.75 at 300 ppm · EUR 44.79 with EUR 150 chargeback. What is the best price you could sign today?

turns.speaker: supplier
turns.from: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
turns.text: Thanks for confirming the 15900 pieces volume! … €45.50 per unit for the 300 ppm package with a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint is the absolute best price we can sign today. … Which volume can you commit to?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: We commit to a binding volume of 15900 pieces a year over 12 months, our full need for this part. … EUR 45.02 at 300 ppm · EUR 45.06 with EUR 150 chargeback. What is the best price you could sign today on one of these packages?

turns.speaker: supplier
turns.from: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
turns.text: This is our last price, take it or leave it. Our terms: a price of €45.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. … We still need faster payment to make this work, cash is tight right now.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: Parley accepts offer:70140-5 (no e-mail text, an accept action).

turns.speaker: supplier
turns.from: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
turns.text: Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. We are very glad to work together with you and are looking forward to being a strong long-term partner for your company.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: Six rounds: €47.00 down to €45.50, and the quality commitment from 6,400 down to 300 ppm. Score 0.71. Tacto's own house agent scored 0.31 on this case.
